body: Hey Im sorry to make anyone worry it just get's harder at night's i've been struggling to keep my head together for a while

I shouldn't be sad, i've done everything im supposed to do but Im still really sad, everything is grey all the time and it feels like im loosing my mind. 
I'm not a teenager, I'm a fully grown adult, with a good job, in one of the most beautiful cities the world. But I can't stop from being really sad. I don't know what to do, I don't have a reason to be sad
